summary: BioMar reported falling prices but increased sales volumes in a recent period. The article discusses the simultaneous trends of lower unit prices and higher quantity sales in the company's aquaculture feed business.
title: Prisfall og volumøkning for Biomar

summary: BioMar has achieved lower feed prices while simultaneously increasing its sales volume, indicating improved operational efficiency and market position. The development reflects positive momentum in the company's commercial performance during the period covered by the report for the aquaculture sector publication iLaks (Norwegian aquaculture industry publication).
